body: Founder: 'bots should consider healing more than one tick at the fountain sometimes.' Fixed real flapping bug: retreat decision was recomputed from scratch every tick off only current HP fraction (no memory), so a bot could barely cross back over the 25% entry threshold after one heal-tick and immediately leave. Fixed with a real two-threshold state machine (persistent retreating_to_fountain flag, 25% entry / 90% exit). Also: new arena_bot_tick_rl_cast() applies the trained RL policy's cast_q/w/r outputs, gated to only Unicorn/Duck (the trained pairing) -- every other hero keeps the existing heuristic. Full suite green.
title: fix: fountain-retreat flapping (real hysteresis) + RL policy now drives casting for its trained pairing
